finding.statement: On a balanced type-(ii) geometric fibre over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero (hypotheses (CE)+(N)+(BAL) at (g,n) = (6,6), with psi : C -> Y the bielliptic double cover of the smooth plane cubic Y, reduced branch divisor B of degree ten, N = O_{P^2}(1)|_Y and L = psi^*N), the geometric monodromy image of pi_1^et(|L|^{rs}) -> S_6 is EXACTLY the wreath product W = S_2 wr S_3 of order 48, not merely contained in it. The proof is: (1) H^0(L) = psi^*H^0(N) exactly, since h^0(N) = 3 and h^0(N tensor M^{-1}) = 0 (degree -2), so |L| is the dual plane and the three fibres of psi over a line section give a global 2+2+2 block system, whence G <= W; (2) the discriminant is Y^vee union the ten lines Delta_b (b in B), Delta_b is not a component of the irreducible degree-six Y^vee, and Kummer inertia at a general point of Delta_b -- where the moving intersection point of the line with Y is a uniformizer on a transverse trait and psi is simply ramified at b -- is a within-block transposition; (3) the degree-three block cover is the restriction of the P^1-bundle over the irreducible Y, hence irreducible, giving transitivity in S_3, and a general nonflex tangent to Y away from B swaps two blocks, giving a transposition, so the image in S_3 is all of S_3; (4) conjugating the within-block transposition by lifts of the transitive S_3-image gives all three within-block transpositions, which generate the kernel (S_2)^3, and together with surjectivity onto S_3 and containment in W this forces G = W.
